title: The Whisper Behind the Library Wall
central_conflict: a whispering sound disturbed readers beside the library wall
decisive_choice: air passed through a narrow gap behind a loose ventilation grille
resolution: secured the grille and restored quiet airflow
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered a whispering sound disturbed readers beside the library wall before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they closed the windows but the noise continued; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized air passed through a narrow gap behind a loose ventilation grille; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they secured the grille and restored quiet airflow, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: The Dome That Would Not Follow the Stars

decisive_choice: a bent guide wheel caught on a damaged section of track
resolution: replaced the wheel and tested a complete dome rotation

title: The Crates That Arrived Empty
central_conflict: harvest crates reached the barn with their lids closed but fruit missing
decisive_choice: a loose panel in the cart floor let fruit roll out along the road
resolution: repaired the cart floor and collected the fallen fruit
